## Accessibility (UI changes)

- [ ] Keyboard-only navigation works: every interactive element is reachable and operable, and nothing traps focus
- [ ] Focus is visible on all interactive elements, and focus order follows the visual/reading order
- [ ] Contrast meets 4.5:1 for body text (3:1 for large text and for UI components / graphical objects)
- [ ] Screen-reader semantics are correct: accessible names on controls and images, landmarks present, heading levels in order
- [ ] No serious or critical axe violations on the pages touched

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`, `refactor:`, `test:`, `ci:`, `perf:`; `!` or a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer for breaking changes)
- [ ] Tests added/updated (or not needed)
- [ ] `pnpm gate` passes locally
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md`, `SPEC.md`, `PLAN.md`, `docs/**`) if behavior changed
- [ ] No secrets committed (`.env*` stays untracked; placeholders only)
- [ ] Any content/definition wording I added is either quoted from a source I cited (with its license) or my own original wording, and I have the right to contribute it under the repo's licenses
